label: Argonian
description: Saxhleel. Black Marsh raised it, and Black Marsh is not gentle.
notes: Beast races carry their own head, eye and mouth meshes and their own body textures, so they substitute rather than tint. Tails are not built: the 99-bone humanoid skeleton this rig is cut from has no tail bones, and Skyrim animates tails from a separate auxbone skeleton and clip set.
